open_points.subject: record_change
open_points.text: record_change: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] A content record is written with its order-free lists in the order content_identity sorts them before hashing — ports by (direction, name), flow nodes by node_id, flow edges by (to_node, to_port, from_node, from_port), flow constants by (to_node, to_port) — never in the order a caller submitted them, so equal content submitted in another order is the same record with the same lists, and every read returns those lists in that order; an OperationBinding, a lifecycle record, writes its inputs and outputs the same way, ports by (direction, name), the name order A08 checks a proposal's ports in; every other list, and every JSON value, keeps its order.
open_points.question: Either restore content_identity to IMPORTS and its imported function signature, or rewrite the note so it does not name the unavailable content_identity symbol.
